# Awesome Grok Imagine Video 2.0 Prompts and Examples

A curated collection for anyone exploring Grok Imagine Video 2.0 prompts and examples: original creator prompts, video previews, source links, and practical adaptation notes for cinematic scenes, realistic vlogs, sci-fi worlds, anime characters, and dialogue.

**Model version note:** The initial examples are Grok Imagine videos with original creator post links. Their exact model versions are unconfirmed, so they are labeled Grok Imagine Video rather than verified 2.0 outputs. Prompt text retains its source language and wording.

**[Watch videos and browse Grok Imagine Video prompts and examples](<https://gvid.app/grok-imagine-video-2-prompts>)**

The collection currently contains **50 examples**, with collection entries reviewed through **2026-10-06**.

## How to use these prompts

1. Open the gallery to watch the result, then choose a scene or camera style you want to explore.
2. Copy the original prompt below. Check the adaptation notes for missing reference images or other required inputs.
3. Adapt the subject, setting, action, camera movement, and dialogue for your own idea. Results can vary by model version and input assets.

## Late-Night Study Vlog

[![Late-Night Study Vlog](<https://cdn.gvid.app/gvid/public/models/grok-imagine/korean-student-vlog-smartphone-video-8761-poster.webp>)](<https://x.com/iamahmedfaraz66/status/2085574151058677777>)

A five-shot smartphone vlog prompt describes a study break with natural gestures and warm desk lighting.

**Model:** Grok Imagine Video

```text
Ultra-realistic vertical smartphone video, 10 seconds. A beautiful young Korean woman is taking a short break while studying at her cozy desk late at night. She wears the same oversized light gray hoodie. Warm desk lamp lighting creates a comfortable atmosphere, with aesthetic wall posters, books, an open notebook, an iced coffee, and an open laptop in the background. The video is filmed with a handheld front-facing smartphone camera, featuring subtle natural movement and authentic smartphone autofocus.

Shot 1 (0–2s): She adjusts the phone slightly as if she has just started recording, smiles softly, and blinks naturally while resting her chin on her sleeve.

Shot 2 (2–4s): She glances toward her notebook, picks up a pen, underlines one sentence, then looks back at the camera with a tired but satisfied smile.

Shot 3 (4–6s): She stretches her shoulders gently, brushes a loose strand of hair behind her ear, and exhales with a relaxed expression. The warm desk lamp creates soft highlights on her face.

Shot 4 (6–8s): She reaches for the iced coffee, takes one small sip, sets it down naturally, then laughs quietly as if reacting to something off-camera.

Shot 5 (8–10s): She gives a playful wink, points briefly toward the open notebook as if saying "back to studying," then smiles warmly at the camera before lowering her gaze and continuing to write.

Style: Ultra-photorealistic, realistic smartphone selfie video, natural body language, authentic facial micro-expressions, subtle breathing, realistic blinking, accurate hand movement, lifelike hair physics, natural hoodie fabric movement, warm tungsten desk lamp, soft room ambience, smartphone autofocus breathing, slight handheld camera shake, shallow depth of field, cinematic yet authentic vlog aesthetic, HDR, 24 fps, 8K, no exaggerated expressions, no unrealistic camera motion, no AI artifacts.
```

### How to adapt it

Use the timed beats as a structure, then replace the desk activity and personal gestures.

<a id="grok-imagine-travel-vlog-prompt-11680"></a>

## Fantasy Travel Selfie Vlog

[![Fantasy Travel Selfie Vlog](<https://cdn.gvid.app/gvid/public/models/grok-imagine/grok-imagine-travel-vlog-prompt-11680-poster.webp>)](<https://x.com/john87445528/status/2104992239713767535>)

A Chinese prompt stages a 15-second selfie adventure with giant machines, a cave giant, dialogue, and a hard cut.

**Model:** Grok Imagine Video

```text
15秒，9:16竖屏，照片级写实手机旅行vlog，全程由成年女主亲自使用前置镜头自拍。女主身份参考#1 @0ba07db1-974c-467d-80dc-d9dffddac0ba ，服装、鞋袜和饰品严格参考#2 @c6a3d787-bf2f-4ae9-a647-8da9db2702e3 ，不使用场景图中的人物替换女主。场景参考#3 @cf1b1405-e241-46d5-818c-7838463fe334 的云海机械巨像与#4 @7953261f-23e7-4c97-b6a0-14bcf07aabe4 的洞穴巨人。两个地点之间使用明确旅行跳剪，表示中间路程已经省略，不表现成一步跨越空间。

她始终右手持手机，左手用于扶岩、保持平衡。手机在脸前约一臂距离，广角自拍中脸位于画面一侧，环境从肩后展开。人物与环境共享自然光、阴影、尘埃和风，保留真实皮肤纹理。只有符合脚步和手腕动作的抖动、短暂曝光调整与运动模糊。无美颜、无配乐、无字幕。

【0—4秒】

云海上方的宽阔岩台，女主沿远离崖缘的内侧缓慢行走。她侧转身体，让两尊嵌在山体中的金色机械巨像出现在肩后：巨大的胸甲占据背景，腿部消失在云层中，远处几名旅行者显得极小。

夕阳照亮她一侧脸颊，风掀动发梢。她先仰头，再看镜头，带着压不住的惊叹轻声说：

“这景区，保安比山还高。”

【4—7秒】

她停下来继续仰望。其中一尊巨像胸口的橙光缓慢增强，头部发生极小幅度转动；片刻后，低沉机械声传到岩台。

她先听声，再抬眼确认，原本的笑容逐渐收住。左手下意识扶住身旁岩壁，手机稍微收近。她不再说话，只短促吸气。

背景旅行者各自停步观察，没有整齐划一地转头。

【7—11秒】

明确硬切，省略转场路程：她已经来到参考#4的洞穴外侧碎石通道。

光线变为洞口反射的灰白日光，身后有羊群、木栅栏和散落的篮筐。她原本沿通道行走，一名惊慌的古代士兵从她左侧跑过，紧接着又有两人绕过碎石奔逃。

她先侧身让路，疑惑地追看他们；随后沉重脚步响起，地面细石跳动。她回头看向洞口，身体随之侧转，使巨人的脸从肩后岩壁之间显露出来。

她压低声音说：

“等等……他们不是来排队的。”

【11—15秒】

巨人俯身挤向洞口，肩膀蹭落碎石，扬起的灰尘遮住部分木栅栏。女主立刻停止说话。

她先看清前方退路，再跟着逃离人群沿通道快步离开，右手将手机收近，左臂抬起护住额侧。自拍画面随脚步颠簸，巨人只在肩后短暂出现，不追求完整全身构图。

最后两秒，她侧身进入右侧岩壁凹处，屈膝降低身体，左手撑住岩面。结束画面：她背靠岩壁，右手手机位于胸口略向上，脸上有薄薄浮尘，嘴唇微张、呼吸急促；画面左缘仍能看到洞口方向飘来的灰尘。

声音：高处风声、低频机械声；跳剪后换成羊叫、奔跑脚步、碎石滚动、巨人呼吸和她近距离的喘息。只有女主说出清晰台词，背景人物喊声含混。

禁止第三人称跟拍、航拍、悬空手机、奔跑时持续直视镜头、凭空换装、无视危险微笑讲解。巨人不瞬移到她面前。
```

## Contributing

Suggest an example or correction through a GitHub issue or pull request. Include the original public post, creator attribution, exact published prompt when available, and any explicit model version evidence. Examples without a published prompt are welcome when clearly labeled. Please do not reconstruct missing prompts or claim a model version without evidence.

## Attribution and corrections

Prompt text and media remain attributed to their original creators. Unpublished prompts are never reconstructed. Open a GitHub issue for corrections, attribution changes, or removal requests.
